name: zhunan-cold-storage
description: 竹南冷凍倉儲庫存管理系統

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w worker" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w worker && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w worker && npm run test -w web
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w web && npm run deploy -w worker
scripts.deploy:demo: npm run build -w web && npm run deploy:demo -w worker
